name: H-Baby
source:
A slightly terrible thing has happened...

All of a sudden, an angel and demon girl come uninvited to the protagonist's house. "We've run away!" they exclaim, and are looking for any place to stay. And they can stay here, on the condition that they do absolutely anything requested.
Explore the bodies and hearts of angel Yuuna and devil Aika; two girls you can treat with violence or love.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061752.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
发生了一件稍微可怕的事……一个天使和一个恶魔女孩突然不请自来地出现在主人公家里。“我们逃出来了！”她们喊道，正在寻找任何可以住的地方。她们可以住在这里，条件是绝对服从任何要求。探索天使优奈和恶魔爱花的身体和心灵——这两个你可以用暴力或爱来对待的女孩。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061752.html]DLsite English[/url]]
